initial_application: The same typo was fixed in historical commit 9eff2268e43126ba48c4aaced9d6fb3087969e2c for FHIR-8903, replacing diagosis with diagnosis in source/terminologies-systems.html and source/namingsystem/namingsystem-terminologies.xml and adding the ICD-9-CM diagnosis/procedure code system OIDs. FHIR-8904's own comment records that the typo was already fixed and that the proposed OID was not the code system OID.
additional_context: Later ICD terminology maintenance removed the old diagnosis/procedure-specific ICD-9-CM row when commit 3e1ab0a91df9b00a3c130cae74a9c7a008488a44 introduced an ICD page, and FHIR-41305/commit 11181dd48937a323abc8bea356cfb08003cfb801 later corrected the current ICD URI column to show the ICD-9-CM and ICD-10 root URIs. The current active Code Systems page is linked from source/hierarchy.xml and source/terminology-module.html and points to THO for authoritative external terminology details.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source has no occurrence of the misspelled URI, no occurrence of the old diagnosis-specific URI in source, and no reason to add the value set OID to a code-system URI/OID table.
